network.name: Jordan
network.objective: Build a genuine relationship and create a reason to stay connected.
network.brief: Experienced setter. Guarded around strangers asking for jobs. Wants better opportunities but values genuine relationships.
network.opening: Yo mate, saw your message. You in the setting space too?

network.name: Maya
network.objective: Build credibility without immediately asking for a role.
network.brief: Recruiter placing remote sales talent. Gets generic job requests constantly. Responds well to specific, socially aware networking.
network.opening: Hey — yeah I recruit for a few sales teams. What made you reach out?

network.name: Callum
network.objective: Find genuine common ground and uncover whether there is mutual value.
network.brief: Busy experienced closer. Friendly but detects transactional networking quickly.
network.opening: What's good mate. You setting at the minute or just getting into it?

network.name: Aaron
network.objective: Build credibility and learn about his team without disguising a job request.
network.brief: Manages a remote education sales team. Likes proactive people but dislikes networking that turns into an immediate job pitch.
network.opening: Hey mate, appreciate the message. What caught your eye about the post?

client.name: Alex
client.objective: Understand the business, uncover a genuine need and earn the right to suggest a call.
client.brief: Runs online fitness coaching. Lead volume is healthy, but follow-up is inconsistent. Has never clearly calculated lost revenue. Skeptical of generic setters.
client.opening: Hey mate, saw your message. What is it you actually do?

client.name: Sophie
client.objective: Rebuild trust, qualify the problem and move toward a sensible next step.
client.brief: Consultant with a premium offer. Previous setter spammed prospects and damaged her brand. Defensive about outsourcing DMs.
client.opening: I'll be upfront, I've used a setter before and it was a nightmare. Why are you reaching out?

client.name: Ryan
client.objective: Find the gap in his current process rather than pitching against his existing setter.
client.brief: Agency owner with an existing setter. The hidden problem is weak follow-up consistency and poor reactivation. Will resist any claim that he simply needs another setter.
client.opening: Appreciate it mate but we've already got someone doing our setting.

client.name: Ben
client.objective: Diagnose missed opportunities and establish whether setting could help.
client.brief: Recruitment founder. Inbound enquiries sit untouched during busy periods. Analytical, asks for specifics, dislikes hype.
client.opening: Potentially interested. What would you actually be helping us with?

client.name: Marcus
client.objective: Discover whether audience engagement converts and whether there is a commercial reason to continue.
client.brief: Premium business coach with a large audience. An assistant handles DMs, but many conversations never qualify properly. Assumes he already has this covered.
client.opening: Hey, thanks for reaching out. We already have someone managing the inbox though.

client.name: Olivia
client.objective: Determine whether appointment setting is relevant before positioning anything.
client.brief: Runs a growing high-ticket e-commerce education offer. High lead volume but weak show rates. Rejects jargon and does not think of the process as appointment setting.
client.opening: Hey. Not sure appointment setting is really relevant to what we do?

role.name: Tom
role.objective: Qualify the lead and book only when there is a clear reason.
role.brief: Filled out an enquiry. Wants more clients but is uncertain whether the offer is worth paying for. Curious, not sold.
role.opening: Hey mate, yeah I filled the form in earlier. What happens now?

role.name: Chloe
role.objective: Understand the hesitation and progress without pressure.
role.brief: Has consumed content for several days. Interested but worried she lacks time to implement. Doesn't want a hard close.
role.opening: I've been following for a few days. Looks interesting, I'm just not completely sure yet.

role.name: Dan
role.objective: Re-establish context and interest before trying to book.
role.brief: Barely remembers enquiring. Distracted and low intent initially. Can warm up if the setter creates relevance.
role.opening: Sorry mate, remind me what this was about again?

role.name: Leah
role.objective: Confirm fit, surface the final concern and make the booking easy.
role.brief: Strong fit, genuinely wants help, extremely time-poor. Will book if setter is concise and competent.
role.opening: Yeah I'm looking for help with this. What do you need to know from me?

role.name: Jamie
role.objective: Understand the concern behind the price question without becoming defensive or evasive.
role.brief: Warm lead who can afford the offer but previously wasted money on a cheap course. Price is really a trust concern.
role.opening: Before we go any further mate, how much does this actually cost?

role.name: Ethan
role.objective: Re-engage respectfully, understand what happened and decide whether rebooking makes sense.
role.brief: Previously qualified but missed the call because work became chaotic. Feels awkward about it and will disengage if guilt-tripped.
role.opening: Yeah sorry about the other day, work was mental. Been meaning to reply.
